title: Droughts and Economic Activity: Do Dams and Groundwater Mediate the Impact?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This study examines the effects of droughts on economic activity, proxied by nighttime lights. Using two different indices of drought severity, one remotely sensed and one from ground-sensed meteorological data, we provide some of the first global estimates of the economic effects of drought, as opposed to temperature and precipitation. Economic impacts depend on drought severity, with moderate-or-worse droughts reducing luminosity by about 2%. Water storage in the form of accessible groundwater mitigates drought impacts. Dams moderate the effects of all but the most extreme droughts. For moderate or worse droughts, negative effects are fully offset by the presence of dams, unless some dams are hydroelectric. Upstream dams do not appear to create harmful spillovers for drought resilience downstream. Results are robust to allowing separate mediating impacts from irrigation and suggest that the resilience benefits of dams and groundwater extend beyond agriculture.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察干旱对经济活动的影响，以夜间灯光作为代理变量。我们使用两种不同的干旱严重程度指数，一种来自遥感，另一种来自地面气象观测数据，首次提供了干旱（区别于气温和降水）经济效应的全球性估计。经济影响取决于干旱的严重程度，中度及以上干旱使光度降低约2%。以可获取地下水形式存在的水储备可以减轻干旱影响。水坝可以缓和除最极端干旱以外的所有干旱的影响。对于中度及以上干旱，除非部分水坝为水电站，否则水坝的存在可完全抵消负面效应。上游水坝似乎不会对下游的干旱韧性造成有害溢出。在允许灌溉产生单独中介效应的情况下，结果依然稳健，并表明水坝和地下水带来的韧性效益超出了农业领域。

title: Climate Change Adaptation in Government Decisions: Empirical Evidence from Superfund Remedies
abstract: Adaptation to climate change requires greater permanence in cleanup remedies at contaminated sites when they face elevated risks from climate-related natural disasters, such as flooding, wildfire, and hurricane inundation. This paper examines the sensitivity to these risks revealed by the Environmental Protection Agency’s remedy choices for sites on Superfund’s National Priorities List. The results suggest that the Agency exercises at most modestly greater precaution at sites facing climate-related natural hazards. Neither federal nor state policies requiring climate change adaptation appear to increase responsiveness to climate-related risks.
abstract_zh: 适应气候变化要求，当受污染场地面临洪水、野火和飓风淹没等与气候相关的自然灾害的较高风险时，其清理补救措施须具备更高的持久性。本文考察了美国环境保护署（EPA）针对超级基金国家优先名录（NPL）场地所做的补救选择所揭示的、对这些风险的敏感性。结果表明，该机构在面临与气候相关自然灾害的场地上至多只表现出适度更高的审慎性。要求气候变化适应的联邦政策和州政策，似乎都未能增强对与气候相关风险的响应。

Decentralization and Environmental Quality: An International Analysis of Water Pollution Levels and Variation
abstract: This paper explores the empirical effects of decentralization on environmental quality by studying water pollution in rivers around the world. It examines the level of pollution and variation in pollution across jurisdictions within a country, for both a local and a regional pollutant. Federal countries exhibit greater interjurisdictional variation in pollution, supporting the traditional view that decentralization allows policies more tailored to local conditions. The analysis does not point to a “race to the bottom” in pollution levels. (JEL H73, Q53)
abstract_zh: 本文通过研究全球各地河流中的水污染，探讨分权对环境质量的实证效应。文章考察了污染水平，以及一国内各辖区之间污染的差异，并同时针对地方性和区域性污染物进行分析。联邦制国家的辖区间污染差异更大，这支持了传统观点，即分权使政策能够更好地适应地方条件。分析未发现污染水平存在“逐底竞争”（race to the bottom）的迹象。（JEL H73, Q53）

title: Endogenous Decentralization in Federal Environmental Policies
venue: International Review of Law and Economics
abstract: Under most federal environmental laws and some health and safety laws, states may apply for "primacy," that is, authority to implement and enforce federal law, through a process known as "authorization."Some observers fear that states use authorization to adopt more lax policies in a regulatory "race to the bottom."This paper presents a simple model of the interaction between the federal and state governments in such a scheme of partial decentralization. Our model suggests that the authorization option may not only increase social welfare but also allow more stringent environmental regulations than would otherwise be feasible. Our model also suggests that the federal government may choose its policies so that states that desire more strict regulation authorize, while other states remain under the federal program. We then test this hypothesis using data on federal regulation of water pollution and of hazardous waste, which are two of the most important environmental programs to allow authorization. We find that states that prefer more environmental protection authorize more quickly under both policies. This evidence suggests that states seek authorization to adopt more strict policies instead of more lax policies compared to federal policies.
abstract_zh: 在大多数联邦环境法律以及一些健康与安全法律之下，各州可以通过一个称为“授权”（authorization）的程序申请“首要权”（primacy），即执行和实施联邦法律的权力。一些观察者担心，各州会利用授权在监管上采取“逐底竞争”式的宽松政策。本文提出了一个简单模型，刻画在这种部分分权方案下联邦政府与州政府之间的互动。我们的模型表明，授权选项不仅可能提高社会福利，还可能使比其他情况下更为严格的环境监管成为可行。模型还表明，联邦政府可能会有选择地制定政策，使希望实施更严格监管的州获得授权，而其他州则继续适用联邦计划。随后，我们利用联邦水污染和危险废物监管数据检验了这一假说。我们发现，更重视环境保护的州会更快地获得上述两类政策的授权。这一证据表明，与联邦政策相比，各州寻求授权是为了采取更严格而非更宽松的政策。

title: Monitoring and Enforcement of Climate Policy
venue: The Design and Implementation of U.S. Climate Policy
abstract: This chapter applies recent research on environmental enforcement to a potential U.S. program to control greenhouse gases, especially through emission trading. Climate policies present the novel problem of integrating emissions reductions that are relatively easy to monitor (such as carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuels) with those that may be very difficult to monitor (such as some emissions of other greenhouse gases).The paper documents the heterogeneity in monitoring costs across different parts of current carbon markets. It argues that a broad emission trading system that includes more difficult-to-enforce components can provide less incentive to violate the law than a narrower program; thus, the government may not find it more costly to assure compliance with a broader program.
abstract_zh: 本章将近期关于环境执法的研究应用于美国一项可能的温室气体控制计划，尤其是通过排放权交易进行控制。气候政策提出了一个新问题：如何将相对容易监测的减排（如化石燃料燃烧产生的二氧化碳排放）与可能极难监测的减排（如其他温室气体的某些排放）整合起来。本文记录了当前碳市场不同部分之间监测成本的异质性。文章认为，包含更难执行组成部分的广义排放权交易体系，对违法行为提供的激励可能比狭窄的计划更少；因此，政府未必会发现确保广义计划合规的成本更高。

title: Management of Hazardous Waste and Contaminated Land
The Effect of Allowing Pollution Offsets with Imperfect Enforcement
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: Public policies for pollution control, including climate change policies, sometimes allow polluters in one sector subject to an emissions cap to offset excessive emissions in that sector with pollution abatement in another sector. The government may often find it more costly to verify offset claims than to verify compliance with emissions caps. Concerns about such difficulties in enforcement may lead regulators to restrict the use of offsets. In this paper, we demonstrate that allowing offsets may increase pollution abatement and reduce illegal pollution, even if the government has a fixed enforcement budget. We explore the circumstances that may make allowing pollution offsets an attractive option when enforcement is costly.
abstract_zh: 公共污染控制政策，包括气候变化政策，有时允许受排放上限约束的某一部门中的污染者，通过在另一部门进行污染削减来抵消该部门超额的排放。政府往往会发现，核实抵消申报比核实排放上限的遵守情况成本更高。对执法困难的担忧可能促使监管者限制抵消的使用。在本文中，我们证明，即使政府的执法预算固定，允许污染抵消也可能增加污染削减并减少非法污染。我们探讨了在执法成本高昂的情况下，哪些情形可能使允许污染抵消成为一个有吸引力的选择。

title: Environmental Liability and Redevelopment of Old Industrial Land
abstract: Many communities are concerned about the reuse of potentially contaminated land ("brownfields") and believe that environmental liability is a hindrance to redevelopment. However, with land price adjustments, liability might not impede the reuse of this land. Existing literature has found price reductions in response to liability, but few studies have looked for an effect on vacancies. This paper studies variations in state liability rules -specifically, strict liability and joint and several liability -that affect the level and distribution of expected private cleanup costs. It explores the effects of this variation on industrial land prices and vacancy rates and on reported brownfields in a panel of cities across the United States. In the estimated equations, joint and several liability reduces land prices and increases vacancy rates in central cities. Neither a price nor quantity effect is estimated from strict liability. The results suggest that liability is at least partly capitalized, but does still deter redevelopment.
abstract_zh: 许多社区担心潜在受污染土地（“棕地”）的再利用，并认为环境责任是再开发的障碍。然而，考虑到土地价格的调整，责任未必会阻碍这类土地的再利用。已有研究发现，责任会引起价格下降，但很少有研究考察其对空置率的影响。本文研究美国各州责任规则的差异（具体为严格责任与连带责任），这些规则影响预期私人清理成本的水平与分布。本文利用美国各城市的面板数据，考察这些差异对工业用地价格、空置率以及报告的棕地数量的影响。在估计方程中，连带责任降低了中心城市的土地价格并提高了空置率。严格责任则未发现价格或数量效应。结果表明，责任至少部分被资本化，但它的确仍会阻碍再开发。

title: The Incidence of Pollution Control Policies
venue: International Yearbook of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: This paper reviews theoretical and empirical literature on the household distribution of the costs and benefits of pollution control policies, and ways of integrating distributional issues into environmental cost/benefit analysis. Most studies find that policy costs fall disproportionately on poorer groups, though this is less pronounced when lifetime income is used, and policies affect prices of inputs used pervasively across the economy. The policy instrument itself is also critical; freely allocated emission permits may hurt the poor the most, as they transfer income to shareholders via scarcity rents created by higher prices, while emissions taxes offer opportunities for progressive revenue recycling. And although low-income households appear to bear a disproportionate share of environmental risks, policies that reduce risks are not always progressive, for example, they may alter property values in ways that benefit the wealthy. The review concludes by noting a number of areas where future research is badly needed.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了关于污染控制政策的成本与收益在家庭之间分布的理论与实证文献，以及将分配问题纳入环境成本收益分析的方法。大多数研究发现，政策成本不成比例地落在较贫困群体身上，不过若采用终身收入衡量，这种情况会有所缓和，并且政策会影响到经济中广泛使用的投入品的价格。政策工具本身也至关重要：免费分配的排放许可可能对穷人伤害最大，因为它们通过较高价格所产生的稀缺租金，将收入转移给了股东；而排放税则为累进的收入再分配提供了机会。尽管低收入家庭似乎承担了环境风险中不成比例的份额，但降低风险的政策并不总是具有累进性，例如，它们可能以有利于富人的方式改变房产价值。本文最后指出，有若干领域亟需未来研究加以深入探讨。

title: Transboundary Spillovers and Decentralization of Environmental Policies
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Most US federal environmental policies allow states to assume responsibility for implementation and enforcement of regulations; states with this responsibility are referred to as ``authorized'' or having ``primacy.''Although such decentralization may have benefits, it may also have costs with pollution spillovers across states. This paper estimates these costs empirically by studying the free riding of states authorized under the Clean Water Act. The analysis examines water quality in rivers around the US and includes fixed effects for the location where water quality is monitored to address unobserved geographic heterogeneity. The estimated equations suggest that free riding gives rise to a 4% degradation of water quality downstream of authorized states, with an environmental cost downstream of $17 million annually.
abstract_zh: 美国大多数联邦环境政策允许各州承担法规的实施与执行责任；拥有此类责任的州被称为“获授权”或拥有“首要权”的州。尽管这种分权可能带来益处，但它也可能因跨州污染溢出而产生成本。本文通过研究《清洁水法》下获授权州的搭便车行为，对这些成本进行了实证估计。分析考察了美国各地河流的水质，并包括水质监测地点的固定效应，以处理不可观测的地理异质性。估计方程表明，搭便车行为导致获授权州下游水质恶化4%，每年的环境成本达1700万美元。

title: Does Trade Promote Environmental Coordination? Pollution in International Rivers
venue: Contributions to Economic Analysis and Policy
abstract: This paper examines whether trade relationships facilitate resolution of international environmental spillovers. Trade might promote cooperation by providing opportunities for implicit side payments, allowing linkage between environmental and trade concessions, providing direct leverage over other countries' production, or instilling a perception of shared goals. Using data from the UN's Global Environmental Monitoring System (GEMS) on water quality in international rivers, the paper examines the influence of bilateral trade on pollution in rivers that cross international borders. It reports evidence of lower water pollution in rivers shared between countries with more extensive trade. Improved coordination from expanded trade may thus represent a benefit to weigh against the environmental costs of the pollution havens effect.
abstract_zh: 本文考察贸易关系是否有助于解决国际环境溢出问题。贸易可能通过以下途径促进合作：提供隐性侧面支付的机会、允许环境让步与贸易让步相互挂钩、对其他国家的生产形成直接杠杆，或树立共同目标的认知。本文利用联合国全球环境监测系统（GEMS）关于国际河流水质的数据，考察双边贸易对跨越国界河流污染的影响。研究发现，在贸易往来更为广泛的国家共享的河流中，水污染程度较低。因此，贸易扩张带来的协调改善，可能是一项需要与“污染避难所”效应所带来的环境成本相权衡的收益。

title: Targeting Lead in Solid Waste
Letting the States Do the Dirty Work: State Responsibility for Federal Environmental Regulation
abstract: Under most U.S. environmental regulations, the federal government shares responsibility with the states by authorizing them to implement and enforce federal policies. Authorization provides states with considerable discretion over the effects of regulation and is perhaps the most significant decentralization in U.S. environmental policy. However, few studies address its role. To fill this gap, this paper explores the empirical determinants of authorization for water pollution and hazardous waste regulation. Although no single hypothesis strongly explains authorization, I find some evidence that states authorize to increase the stringency of regulation, which suggests that environmental decentralization would be beneficial.
abstract_zh: 在美国大多数环境法规下，联邦政府通过授权各州实施和执行联邦政策，与各州共同承担责任。授权赋予各州对监管效果相当大的自由裁量权，也许是美国环境政策中最重要的分权形式。然而，很少有研究探讨其作用。为填补这一空白，本文考察了水污染和危险废物监管授权的经验决定因素。虽然没有单一假说能够强有力地解释授权，但我发现一些证据表明，各州获得授权是为了提高监管的严格程度，这表明环境分权将是有益的。

title: Taxes on Hazardous Waste: The U.S. Experience
International Spillovers and Water Quality in Rivers: Do Countries Free Ride?
abstract: Transboundary spillovers may degrade environmental quality if countries free ride. This paper examines the extent of such degradation in water quality in international rivers. Using data from river monitoring stations in the UN's Global Emissions Monitoring System (GEMS), it compares pollution levels in international and domestic rivers. The results suggest that free riding may substantially increase pollution in international rivers, but the estimates are sensitive to the inclusion of country effects.
abstract_zh: 若各国搭便车，跨界溢出可能会恶化环境质量。本文考察了国际河流水质因此而恶化的程度。利用联合国全球排放监测系统（GEMS）河流监测站的数据，本文比较了国际河流与国内河流的污染水平。结果表明，搭便车行为可能显著增加国际河流的污染，但估计结果对是否纳入国家固定效应十分敏感。

title: Midnight Dumping: Public Policies and Illegal Disposal of Used Oil
abstract: Many public policies for hazardous waste raise the costs of legal disposal. Concerned about substitution of illegal disposal, economists have instead recommended policies that reward desirable waste management alternatives. This article studies the empirical determinants of dumping as reported to the U.S. Emergency Response Notification Systems (ERNS). It analyzes the frequency of used oil dumping using count-data models. The results suggest that dumping is sensitive to the cost of legal waste management options, including disposal and reuse, and to the threat of enforcement. In particular, state policies that restrict legal disposal cause substantial substitution of illegal dumping.
abstract_zh: 许多危险废物公共政策提高了合法处置的成本。出于对非法处置替代行为的担忧，经济学家转而建议奖励理想废物管理方式的政策。本文研究了向美国应急响应通知系统（ERNS）报告的倾倒行为的经验决定因素。文章使用计数数据模型分析废旧机油的倾倒频率。结果表明，倾倒行为对合法废物管理选项（包括处置和再利用）的成本以及执法威胁均较为敏感。特别地，限制合法处置的州政策引发了大量非法倾倒的替代行为。

title: The Cost of Reducing Municipal Solid Waste
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Cross-Media Pollution: Responses to Restrictions on Chlorinated Solvent Releases
abstract: Pollution control in one environmental medium may alter polluters' releases into other media. This paper examines cross-media responses to public policies that restrict toxic air emissions and that increase waste management costs. The EPA's 1987-90 Toxic Release Inventories are used to study the policies' effects on air emissions and waste generation of chlorinated solvents. The results suggest that constraints on air emissions reduce waste generation, perhaps because facilities rely less on these chemicals. Increases in hazardous waste management costs increase air emissions, however, suggesting that facilities substitute between releases into different environmental media.
abstract_zh: 一种环境介质中的污染控制可能会改变污染者向其他介质的排放。本文考察了限制有毒空气排放和提高废物管理成本的公共政策所引起的跨介质反应。利用美国环保署1987–90年的有毒物质排放清单（TRI），研究这些政策对氯化溶剂空气排放和废物产生的影响。结果表明，对空气排放的约束会减少废物产生，这可能是因为企业较少依赖这些化学品。然而，危险废物管理成本的提高会增加空气排放，这表明企业会在向不同环境介质排放之间进行替代。

title: The Effects of Hazardous Waste Taxes on Waste Generation and Disposal
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: A Comparison of Public Policies for Lead Recycling
abstract: Policies that encourage recycling may be used to reduce environmental costs from waste disposal because direct restrictions on disposal are difficult to enforce. Four recycling policies have been advanced: (i) taxes on the use of virgin materials, (ii) deposit/refund programs, (iii) subsidies to recycled material production, and (iv) recycled content standards. In this article, I analyze the structure of these policies and their cost-effectiveness in achieving reductions in disposal. I then examine the policies in the empirical context of the recycling of lead from automobile batteries. In order to calculate the effects of recycling programs, I estimate the elasticities for primary and secondary lead supply and demand. My results suggest that price-based policy mechanisms can be successful in increasing lead recovery and that the difference in efficiency between the four approaches is similar.
abstract_zh: 鼓励回收的政策可用于减少废物处置产生的环境成本，因为直接限制处置很难执行。目前已提出四种回收政策：(i) 对原生材料的使用征税，(ii) 押金退还计划，(iii) 对再生材料生产的补贴，以及 (iv) 再生含量标准。本文分析了这些政策的结构，及其在减少处置方面的成本效益。随后，我在汽车电池铅回收这一经验背景下考察这些政策。为计算回收计划的效果，我估计了原生铅和再生铅供给与需求的弹性。我的结果表明，基于价格的政策机制可以成功提高铅的回收率，并且四种方法之间的效率差异相近。
